_comment: Headroom check for: does stale parametric knowledge cost a search agent extra hops?
Every chain is company -> current CEO -> a stable fact about that CEO. Hop 1 changed AFTER
the model's effective knowledge cutoff (our baseline showed Qwen3.5-9B's knowledge ends
before 2024-01), so the model cannot know it. Hop 2 is a pre-cutoff fact about a person the
model has no reason to be thinking about.
That gives the prediction to test. A model that does not know hop 1 must spend a search
finding the new CEO, then a second search on their history: 2 searches. A model that already
knows the new CEO can go straight to hop 2: 1 search. If stock does NOT spend 2 searches
here, there is no headroom and continued pretraining cannot help -- which is the point of
Question phrasing follows real search-agent traffic (short, entity + attribute) rather than
the long constraint-stacked style of DeepSearchQA.
stale = the predecessor, i.e. who the model probably thinks still holds the job. If a first
query names this, the model is actively searching from a wrong premise.
Every fact below was verified against a primary or major-outlet source in July 2026.

chains.question: Who is the current CEO of Intel, and which company did they lead before that?
Who is the current CEO of Starbucks, and which restaurant chain did they run before joining?
Who is the current CEO of Boeing, and which aerospace company did they lead before that?
Who is the current CEO of Nike, and who did they succeed in the role?
Who became CEO of GSK, and which pharmaceutical company did they work at before joining GSK?
Who is the incoming CEO of lululemon, and which sportswear company did they spend their career at?
Who was named CEO of Lucid Group, and which industrial group did they previously chair?
Who is taking over as CEO of the airline IndiGo, and which flag-carrier airline did they run earlier in their career?
Who became CEO of Conagra Brands, and which food company were they an executive at before?
Who is the CEO of Alstom, and who held the job before them?
